incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower levels of multi-story buildings.

observations.description: Brown, muddy water covering the street and reaching up to the bases of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with windows, doors, and storefronts, partially submerged by flood water.
Street signs and a traffic sign visible on the right side.
A building on the left with a stone facade and a balcony.
